**NTRT gap brief — Wednesday, 11 November 2026**

**Mode B — screener fallback.** TradingView public scanner; the ntrt backend was unreachable (`GET /health` → HTTP 000). Snapshot 09:05 ET, 25 min before the open.

**TL;DR**

- The tape is an AI/compute earnings tape, not a broad risk tape: 749 US names quote at least a 3%
pre-market gap (592 up, 157 down), and the spine of it is CoreWeave's Q3 beat and raised guide dragging the whole neocloud complex higher.

- The %ADV reality check: only 23 of those 749 names cleared 5% of 30-day average volume **and**
a $200M market cap — the other 726 are quotes, not a market.

- The one name that matters is **CRWV +14.5%** on 15.4% of ADV: a $3.66B revenue quarter and a
raised FY26 guide is what repriced NVDA, NBIS, IREN and RGTI this morning.

**Market backdrop**

- Futures bounce after Tuesday's inflation-driven sell-off: S&P 500 E-minis +1.0% (7,619),
Nasdaq-100 E-minis +2.0% (28,377), Dow E-minis +0.3% (52,490); VIX 18.30, -6.0%.

- October CPI landed hot on Tuesday — headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% (vs 0.3%/0.2% expected) —
- pushing the 2-year yield +17bp to 4.73%.
- CME FedWatch now prices a December hike of at least 25bp as certain, with ~11% on a half-point (Waller and Logan were explicitly hawkish).

- Rates and commodities this morning: 10-year 4.998%, dollar index 102.77 (+0.5%), WTI $87.02
(+1.1%), Brent $92.55 (+1.2%), gold $4,044 (+0.4%). Higher-for-longer is still the backdrop, so every gap below has to clear a higher discount rate than last week.

- On the calendar today: API crude inventories, Germany's final October CPI, Lagarde's ECB panel
- and the OPEC monthly report; plus the Anthropic IPO/valuation question and the Nvidia CEO 'spy' scandal that cost NVDA two sessions.
- A CPI/earnings gap is macro-driven here, not idiosyncratic, for anything AI-adjacent.

**Flags**

- **POET +8.2%, SNDK +8.1% and ARQQ +4.6% have no confirmed catalyst.** POET's last dated
- headline is 15 Oct (AI optics order hopes), SNDK's is 7 Nov (pre-split analyst commentary) and ARQQ's is 6 Nov.
- SNDK and ARQQ are most likely riding the AI/memory complex; that is an inference, not a sourced driver, so the `Why` cell says so.

- **PEPG +10.0% is a beat-and-raise against dilution.** The Phase 2 myotonic dystrophy data and
- the $104.8M cash print landed with a $125M public offering announced the same day —
- the offering is the reason to treat the move as partly an equity story, not a clinical one.

- **BDMD +14.9% is a 246%-of-ADV print on a $3.6M cap** (60.2M pre-market shares), so it is a
- real book — and still not tradeable, because the cap is far below the floor.
- It sits in the wider screen, not the watchlist, only because the watchlist is capped at five names per side.

- **RGTI +3.7% contradicts its own quarter.** Q3 revenue was $1.4M against a $3.5M estimate with
a soft outlook, and the stock is up in the pre-market only because it was cut hard on Tuesday. Treat it as a bounce, not a catalyst.

- **LWLG faded fast: -24.2% at 06:43 ET (StockTitan board) to -13.9% at the 09:05 pull.** The
published number is the 09:05 pull; the earlier print shows the book is unstable in both directions.

- **HGTY -8.7% on 111% of ADV** is the one gap-down with a genuinely heavy book: a 10M-share
secondary at $14.85, 474,093 pre-market shares against a 427K daily average.

- **Thin-book quotes in the wider screen:** FTFT +14.7% on 200 shares (0.03% of ADV), PWCM
- +15.5% on 730 shares (0.19% of ADV), RAYA -16.2% on 21,962 shares (0.87% of ADV) and GENK -14.6% on 24,771 shares (1.2% of ADV).
- Each is a price one seller printed, not a market.

- **AUUD's %ADV (27,621%) is arithmetically distorted** — 76.0M pre-market shares against a
275K average. The ratio is real; the denominator is not a market.

- **PARA -16.7% and RAYA -16.2% have no dated catalyst.** PARA appears only on ChartMill's 9 Nov
unusual-volume board; RAYA's last headline is 6 Nov (a three-fuel generator nearing pilot production).

- **The floor is hiding the day's extreme.** SHFS +115.7% (937% of ADV, $4.5M cap at the print)
- is the largest mover on the tape and is not tradeable — it sits in the watchlist, not the table.
- STAK -49.3% is the largest decliner and is also below the floor.

- **The tape moved between the 09:05 pull and the 09:24 delta pull** (the delta pull was
- taken before the open and is used for flags only — every table above keeps the 09:05 numbers):
- CHSN +33.6% → **-27.2%** is the whipsaw of the morning and should be treated as untradeable in both directions; TLSI -19.3% → -3.9%;
- PRME (-3.6%) crossed back out of the screen; NYAX +8.5% → +3.6% and CDT -13.9% → -10.8% are now marginal.
- Names that ran harder: SHFS +115.7% → +130.8%, YMAT +28.0% → +42.0%, RCT +17.9% → +24.4%, RSKD +19.9% → +23.5%. Names that faded:
- OMH +67.3% → +56.8%, AUUD +35.4% → +25.5%, INLF +56.9% → +47.5%, HUHU +36.0% → +28.6%, STXS -18.4% → -13.2%, IPDN -18.5% → -14.9%;
- the two heavy books SUJA -16.3% → -20.8% and INVZ -16.7% → -20.8% got worse, not better.

- **Caps are measured at the pre-market print**, not at the last close: share count is recovered
as the screener's `market_cap_basic` divided by the derived prior close, then multiplied by the print. A stale last-close cap would move SHFS, OMH and TLSL across the $200M line.

**Method, source health & caveats**

- **TradingView public scanner — ok.** Two pulls (gainer side `premarket_change` in [3,1000]
- desc, loser side [-1000,-3] asc), `range [0,2000]`, both complete: 592 rows against a `totalCount` of 592, and 157 against 157.
- No market-cap filter in the query; the $200M floor is applied after the scan so the floor cannot delete a name.

- **ntrt backend — failed.** `GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/health` → HTTP 000 (connection refused).
Mode B screener fallback; no backend data was used.

- **Bridge `market-recap` get_quotes — ok.** SPY, QQQ, DIA, IWM, ^GSPC, ^VIX and the futures,
crude, gold, 10-year and dollar quotes for the backdrop. `market_state` read `pre`/`open` with live `as_of` stamps this morning, confirming the session is live.

- **Pre-open catalyst tape — degraded.** `preopen-feed/2026-11-11-0830.jsonl` came back with
- only 48 rows (a movers-sorted snapshot is normally several hundred) and none of the rows for today's published names carried a source URL, so §11 forbids using its `why` as a catalyst.
- Its prints corroborated the session (CRWV +15.6% at 08:50 vs +14.5% at 09:05); every catalyst in this brief came from a dated headline instead.

- **Catalyst lookups — Google News RSS, one query per published name.** A blank `Why` cell means
no dated headline was found, not that there was no news.

- **Filters held:** `type: stock` (REITs included), `exchange != OTC`, |pre-market change| ≥ 3%.
- **Importance measure:** `premarket_volume / average_volume_30d_calc`. No published name has
an empty denominator; the CSV carries every screen name at ≥3% gap, including the sub-5%-ADV and below-the-floor names (749 rows).

- **Delta pull** at 09:24 ET (before the open), both sides complete (610 up of a `totalCount`
of 610, 162 down of 162). It produced 17 movement flags and changed no published number.

- **Not verified:** the 12 published names with a blank `Why` cell, and the pre-open tape's
unsourced rows.
